status_note: Which FICO17 v6 indicators offer N/A, and its words for each. Approved by the operator 19 Nov 2026 (plan 'N/A only where it can happen, with its own label'). One rule: N/A is offered only when the thing the indicator scores could not happen in this lesson; when level 1 already describes 'nothing happened' there is no N/A (the operator's D2 example). D3 has no N/A (option A): its level 1 is 'no student speaks to another'. This file overrides the rubric's na_rule / na_link for every reader (coach form, portal, DC prompt and validator, reports); the rubric sheet itself has no N/A column yet. Coach wording says 'lesson' (the coach saw it), Digital Coach wording says 'transcript' (it read one).
